purpose: Candidate-free semantic foreground extraction audit on the qualified controlled full-window replay.
truth_boundary: Controlled truth metadata is evaluation-only. It must not enter policy features.
candidate_boundary: candidate_flag and candidate_reasons are not used by candidate-free foreground policies. Candidate artifacts are historical diagnostics only.

assignment_states.protected_foreground: Retained because clean evidence or semantic novelty indicates downstream risk.
assignment_states.gray_retained: Retained because current evidence is insufficient for safe operational suppression.
assignment_states.operational_background_suppressed: Suppressed from downstream workload; not a benign label.

policies.description: Protect only explicit clean external evidence risk; suppress the rest except unavailable evidence. This is a stress-test upper bound, not a recommended default.
Protect clean external evidence, rare prefix-origin/path objects, and low visibility only when paired with novelty or evidence.
Suppress only stable recurrent route objects with no clean risk evidence; retain the rest as protected or gray.
Suppress common non-risk route objects while retaining explicit risk, rare prefix-origin-path, and low-visibility risk combinations.
Treat low visibility conservatively, but still suppress stable multi-collector non-risk recurrence.

allowed_policy_features: window recurrence and rarity features derived from event fields
community evidence state and well-known community flags
